title: SVG Motion Path
description: Một vật chạy dọc đường cong chữ S và luôn xoay mũi theo hướng đi.

moworks.author: moworks

options.path: the SVG path to follow (same SVG as the moving group)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: offset-path: S curve of two tangent-continuous cubics (demo M18 84 C48 3 69 13 109 60 S176 107 202 24 in a 220 x 120 box), offset-distance 0 -> 100 %, offset-rotate auto, 1200 ms easeInOutCubic; the same d drawn as a faint guide with end dots. Demo 2.6 s: move from 12 % to 84 %. Small demo: a sine path, arrow ping-pongs every 3 s ease-in-out. Params: path · duration (1.2 s) · ease (power2.inOut) · rotate: tự xoay (auto).
